assertions.name: v21_is_a_hecke_representation
assertions.source: sigma^2 = h sigma + 1 for both generators, the braid relation holds exactly, and chi_(2,1)(sigma_0 sigma_1) = -1 (the standard Hecke character value). Exact in Q(q).

assertions.name: markov_trace_is_a_weighted_character_sum_and_D_kills_1_1_1
assertions.source: TR(z) = w_3(z) chi_3 + w_21(z) chi_21 + w_111(z) chi_111 holds on all six NF basis elements with a UNIQUE weight vector, and w_111(z_D) = 0 exactly (convention D is the two-row trace). So D changes only the three scalars w_lambda; the V_(2,1) block of an element does not contain z at all. Weights: w_3 = (q*z + 1)*(q**3*z + q*z + 1)/((q**2 + 1)*(q**2 - q + 1)*(q**2 + q + 1)), w_21 = -q*(-q + z)*(q*z + 1)/((q**2 - q + 1)*(q**2 + q + 1)), w_111 = q**2*(-q + z)*(-q**3 + q**2*z + z)/((q**2 + 1)*(q**2 - q + 1)*(q**2 + q + 1)).

assertions.name: calibration_reproduces_committed_tr_zD
assertions.source: tr^{z_D}(Delta) for all four elements reproduces qbeta-option-e-required-level.witness.json to 1e-24, so the elements are the dashboard's own.

assertions.name: block_type_is_independent_of_the_L_slot_convention
assertions.source: tr and det of every V_(2,1) block are unchanged under the census's L-/L+ slot swap (reversal is a transpose in this rep).

assertions.name: D_trace_already_contains_the_V21_block
assertions.source: for every element, tr^{z_D}(Delta) = w_3(z_D) chi_3 + w_21(z_D) tr(V21 block) exactly. If a block had real positive spectrum, its cosh would ALREADY be inside eps_D; multiplying a separate cosh on top would count it twice.

assertions.name: no_scored_element_has_an_imaginary_V21_eigenphase
assertions.source: phase types found: ['REAL phase (complex-conjugate spectrum)', 'pi/2 + i a (real spectrum of opposite signs)']. 0 of 4 blocks have real positive spectrum, which is the only case where the half-normalised trace is a cosh >= 1. Delta_S's block is traceless with det = -h^2/4: eigenvalues +-h/2, phase exactly pi/2.

assertions.name: alpha_D_is_real_and_negative_at_q0
assertions.source: alpha_D(q_0) = -0.04048577734064276491884728 (real, < 0); its zero locus is q**3 - q**2 - 1 = 0, the real root of which is ~1.46557 > q_0. alpha_D(q) + alpha_D(1/q) = h^2/2 exactly (the D bar defect), and beta_D = alpha_D - h^2/4 = -0.05141232947377326226935211 is exactly bar-odd. Both are real at real q, so the ladder factor is a cos, <= 1.

assertions.name: beta_D_is_purely_imaginary_on_the_unit_circle_alpha_D_is_not
assertions.source: at q = exp(i log q_0): beta_D = (-2.0880974297595278485e-53 - 0.052926948043156916349j) (real part -2.09e-53), alpha_D = (-0.010847534402365170521 - 0.052926948043156916349j). The bar-odd part turns imaginary there, as the Lean lemma says it must; alpha_D itself does not, because of its bar defect h^2/2. So under D only the bar-odd projection has a definite real/imaginary type.

assertions.name: even_the_wick_rotated_cosh_is_far_too_small
assertions.source: cosh(|Im beta_D|) on that slice = 1.0014009579062729839; the needed phase a = arccosh(F_required) ranges 0.59572051 to 1.1652171 across the four order-zero cells, against |beta_D| = 0.052926948: at least 11.2555x too small. Diagnostic only; no cell is chosen, none is scored.

assertions.name: current_base_V3_has_no_imaginary_V21_eigenphase
assertions.source: V_(2,1) blocks of the corrected-photon vertex, V^3 and V^-3: ['REAL phase (complex-conjugate spectrum)', 'REAL phase (complex-conjugate spectrum)', 'REAL phase (complex-conjugate spectrum)']. det V = det(s0) det(s1)^-1 = 1, so V^3 is in SL_2; a cosh >= 1 would need real positive spectrum, which none has.

assertions.name: vertex_eigenphase_exact_form
assertions.source: tr V = -(1 + h^2) and 2 - tr V^3 = h^4 [3]_q exactly in Q(q), so the V^3 eigenphase is theta = 2 arcsin(h^2 sqrt([3]_q)/2) = 0.07626930096809879343628895 at q_0: real, O(h^2). A ladder factor built on it is cos(theta) = 0.99709290648998204336 < 1.

assertions.name: scored_cell_reproduced_and_cosh_lever_still_far_too_small
assertions.source: |eps_flavour(V^3)| E_0^canonical = 0.325433928734692 MeV (matches qbeta-flavour-weight-split.witness.json); F_required = 2.40397002563 > 1, so a real ladder phase (factor <= 1) cannot reach it. A cosh reading needs a = 1.523897207, against the Wick-rotated |beta_D| = 0.052926948: 28.7925x short. Diagnostic only; CODATA in this ratio only.

description: Diagnostic for beans qou-cds1 / qou-pdix: is the convention-D N=1 eigenphase real (cos <= 1) or imaginary (cosh >= 1)? (1) No scored Delta has a V_(2,1) block with real positive spectrum, the only case giving a cosh. (2) Convention D enters only through the scalar Markov weights, w_111(z_D) = 0, and the D trace already contains the V_(2,1) block, so a separate cosh would double count. (3) The ladder phase alpha_D and its bar-odd part beta_D are real at real q; beta_D is purely imaginary on |q| = 1, but even there its cosh is far below every F_required. No fit, no selection, no wiring.
